investigations.name: Stadtwerke Burgdorf GmbH

evidence.classificationFinding: Operator/public material makes effective charging price dependent on selected mobility/payment provider; AC and 180-kW DC are distinct relevant classes.

investigations.exactGap: No single network tariff is safe. Binding anonymous direct-payment offers must be captured per active EVSE/site, including the 180-kW DC subset and fee components.
investigations.resumeCondition: Authoritative per-EVSE direct-payment export/checkout matrix for the active Burgdorf estate.

investigations.name: CUBOS Service GmbH

evidence.backend: SWARCO/ChargeOne integration and station-configurable pricing require per-EVSE extraction rather than operator-level inference.

investigations.exactGap: Current canonical estate lacks an exhaustive direct-price/fee matrix after backend integration; operator-level examples cannot close the CPO.
investigations.resumeCondition: Bulk public/read-only per-EVSE direct offers from the current backend with site/power/fee fields.

investigations.name: Inselwerke eG
investigations.decision: remain partial; routed to backend extraction rather than broad search
investigations.exactGap: Site-configurable backend classification means an estate-wide anonymous tariff cannot be inferred. Need active EVSE inventory and binding direct offers per site.
investigations.resumeCondition: Authoritative public backend inventory plus per-EVSE anonymous price and fee components.

backendFamilyProgress.m8mit: No new safe unbounded candidate found beyond already promoted Parchim/Bernburg/Rostock and bounded MEGA/Aue cases; avoided repeating bounded m8mit work.
backendFamilyProgress.B3: Advanced three site-configurable candidates and formalized exact backend extraction gaps.

nextSafeAction: Prioritize B1/B3/B6 only when a public/read-only machine-readable backend can enumerate the full estate. Candidate next probes: Stadtwerke Nortorf fixed estate, Stadtwerke Peine DE*SPE QR/browser, or a Mobilithek/AFIR operator with explicit fee fields.
